src/browser-adapter-support.ts.name: Adapter shared types
src/browser-adapter-support.ts.description: Defines the confirmation, signer and identity hooks the adapter takes, plus helpers for the outbox router and the simulated theme.

src/browser-adapter.ts.name: Kehto shell adapter
src/browser-adapter.ts.description: Builds the ShellAdapter that hands each NAP domain to its @kehto/services handler, scoped to the napplet window, and opens approved external links.

src/browser-common.ts.name: NAP-COMMON on Nostr
src/browser-common.ts.description: Answers NAP-COMMON requests (profiles, reactions, reports and similar) by reading relays and publishing signed events.

src/browser-config.ts.name: NAP-CONFIG backend
src/browser-config.ts.description: Stores each napplet's declared config values in the host and shows a page where the developer edits them.

src/browser-dev-runtime.ts.name: Development signer and DMs
src/browser-dev-runtime.ts.description: Creates a throwaway signing key for each page load and a NIP-17 direct-message service that uses it over live relays.

src/browser-device-services.ts.name: Serial and Bluetooth
src/browser-device-services.ts.description: Backs NAP-SERIAL and NAP-BLE with the browser's Web Serial and Web Bluetooth choosers, opened only from an approval click.

src/browser-link.ts.name: External link handoff
src/browser-link.ts.description: Remembers whether an approval click just happened so an approved LINK request may open a new browser tab.

src/browser-lists.ts.name: NAP-LISTS on Nostr
src/browser-lists.ts.description: Answers NAP-LISTS requests from verified NIP-51 and NIP-65 list events, public items only.

src/browser-notify.ts.name: Notification center
src/browser-notify.ts.description: Shows napplet notifications in a host-drawn notification center instead of the browser's own.
